_comment: Hearthbound: Medieval Buildings [End Edition] gates ship on minecraft:end_highlands + minecraft:end_midlands only. Nullscape overrides data/minecraft/dimension/the_end.json and its biome source places end_highlands but NOT end_midlands at all — most of the outer End is nullscape:shadowlands / crystal_peaks / void_barrens instead, so half this structure's intended placement simply did not exist. Nullscape's own minecraft:has_structure/end_city tag lists exactly these three biomes, so it considers all of them suitable for large structures; that is the authority used here rather than a guess. ||  Hearthbound 2026-09-08: Nullscape was REMOVED from the pack when BetterEnd was added, so these plain-string nullscape: ids would fail tag loading outright. Rewritten as required:false so the tag is valid whether or not Nullscape is installed. NOTE: with BetterEnd generating the End instead, these structures need a BetterEnd-biome pass of their own - this file no longer gives them real coverage.
